query:
SELECT 
  DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') as month,
  COUNT(*) as item_count,
  SUM(CAST(stockOnHand AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_stock,
  SUM(CAST(expiryRiskValue AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_expiry_risk,
  SUM(CAST(deadStockValue AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_dead_stock
FROM inventory
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') IN ('2026-05', '2026-06')
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY month;
